issue.title: Add Cloudflare to Flask Hosting Platforms docs?

summary.text: The issue requests adding Cloudflare Workers’ Flask deployment guide to the Hosting Platforms documentation. After discussing concerns about company links appearing promotional, a maintainer indicated that Cloudflare is comparable in scale to existing entries and invited the reporter to open a pull request, while separately sharing the Pallets donation page without promising preferential treatment.

known_facts.text: The reporter supplied a Cloudflare guide for deploying Flask applications on Workers and asked that it be linked from Flask’s Hosting Platforms documentation.
A maintainer initially observed that the examples repository linked by Cloudflare did not contain the referenced example; the reporter later stated that the omitted example had been merged.
The maintainer expressed concern that adding company-submitted links can resemble advertising, but considered Cloudflare comparable in scale to services already listed.
The latest visible maintainer response asks whether the reporter would open a pull request and pass Cloudflare the Pallets donation link.

missing_information: Whether the reporter intends to open the requested documentation pull request.

label_recommendations.name: docs
label_recommendations.reason: The requested change is specifically an addition to Flask’s Hosting Platforms documentation.

draft_reply: Thanks for following up and for adding the referenced example. A documentation PR adding the Cloudflare guide to the Hosting Platforms section would be welcome for review. Please also pass along our donation page to the appropriate people at Cloudflare; as noted above, that is separate from the link and does not imply any promised service. Would you be willing to open the PR?
limitations: The Cloudflare guide, examples repository, Flask documentation, source code, and release history were not independently inspected; this analysis is based on the issue and its five retrieved comments.
Repository searches for “Cloudflare hosting” and “hosting platforms” returned no eligible candidates beyond the target, but those searches are not proof that no duplicate or related issue exists.
No pull request associated with this request was identified or reviewed.
